I'll inspect the repository structure and read `cmd/main.go` to trace engine usage.

ANSWER:
`main()` in `cmd/main.go` makes a single chained call into the engine package: `engine.NewResolver().ResolveKey("x")` — i.e., it calls `engine.NewResolver()` (constructor returning `*Resolver`, defined at `internal/engine/core.go:6`) and then `(*Resolver).ResolveKey` (defined at `internal/engine/core.go:9`), discarding the result. The engine is pulled in via the import at `cmd/main.go:3`. No other engine functions (Cache, Handler, Registry, etc.) are used by main.
